description: Full-stack TypeScript framework built for AI agents: typed server-to-client with zero codegen, SSR for React/Vue/Svelte/Solid/Preact, on Bun/Node/Deno/edge.
rules: Every route that accepts input declares a schema (any Standard Schema library); never read an unvalidated body
Call the API through the typed client inferred from the server type; never hand-write fetch calls against internal routes
Server-only code lives in *.server.ts modules and server functions in *.fn.ts modules; the client build strips both
Run `nifra check` after generating or changing code and fix what it reports
Prefer the verified examples from the docs MCP (https://mcp.nifra.dev) or `nifra_example` over writing nifra code from memory
